items.title: Fact Check: Viral posts claim BJP, PM Modi are offering free recharge after Lok Sabha election results. Here’s the truth
items.snippet_en: Hindustan Times reports that claims of PM Modi offering free recharge have gone viral. The Press Information Bureau (PIB) clarified that neither the Indian Government nor PM Modi is running any such scheme, warning against suspicious links that may lead to data theft and scams.

items.title: Viral message claiming BJP is providing three months of free recharge to all Indian mobile service customers is hoax
items.snippet_en: Telugu Post reports on a viral WhatsApp message claiming the BJP is providing three months of free recharge to all Indian mobile service customers. It debunks the claim, stating no such announcement has been made by the BJP or the central government, and the linked website is not official.

items.title: PM Narendra Modi Offering Free Recharge of Rs 239 to Voters? BJP 2024 Lok Sabha Elections Fact Check
items.snippet_en: The Quint fact-checked a fake post claiming PM Modi was offering free Rs 239 recharge to voters ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha Elections. They found no evidence of such an announcement and warned that the linked website collects user data and could lead to financial scams.

items.title: Is PM Narendra Modi Offering 3 Months of Mobile Recharge For Free? Fact Check Calls Claim Fake
items.snippet_en: LatestLY reports that PIB Fact Check has debunked a viral message claiming PM Narendra Modi is offering three months of free mobile recharge. The government confirmed that no such scheme exists and warned citizens against fraudulent links.

A Facebook post from PIB Fact Check clarifies that a digitally altered video claiming PM Narendra Modi is offering 3 months of free mobile recharge to all students is fake. It states that no such announcement has been made by the Prime Minister.

items.title: PM Modi Free Recharge Claim Fake: PIB Fact Check
items.snippet_en: Prabhat Khabar reiterates that PIB Fact Check has clarified that no such scheme for free mobile recharge is being run by the Prime Minister or the central government. It advises people to be vigilant and not forward such messages.
